scope: Builder self-inspection of original engine frames/native crops plus native Chrome host-time 1x playback under gpu; sampled UI observations, not continuous photon observation. Independent lead review remains owed.

inspection.rock_and_ridges: Coherent relative placement during the sweep; native crops retain ridge shape and attached shadows.
inspection.sphere: Moves left with the authored monotonic sweep and exits before the settled final endpoint.
inspection.endpoints: Agree with yaw 0 and 36; paused output holds without a camera cut.
inspection.cuts_snaps_reversals: None observed in full-source frames, crops and sampled normal-speed playback; submitted yaw has no reversal.
inspection.local_holds: No repeated image bytes or >16 ms source gap during nonendpoint yaw. Maximum 17.018/24.196 ms gaps are in settled/warmup output, retained in timing-review.json.
inspection.gross_pause: None observed in engine motion; player decoder drops are observer loss, not source omissions or panel cadence.

observer_limits: Full movies reached ended=true at rate 1; middle replays seek to 3 or 4.5 s and then run at rate 1. Decoder drops are explicitly retained. OFF witness alone qualifies OS-reported cadence. Movie PTS, engine samples and browser playback are separate measurements.
